scope.application_io: 100 one-byte replies, 4099-byte response using 1–7-byte operations, and 1,048,577-byte response per cycle; buffers remain the roo_io 64-byte defaults
scope.worker_reservations: Sender and RX worker each 2048 bytes; application/producer tasks each 8192 bytes
scope.watermark_units: ESP32 raw watermark units are bytes (StackType_t 1 byte); RP2040 units are words (StackType_t 4 bytes). All free/used fields are normalized to bytes.
scope.esp32_pair: Two physical boards, GPIO4 TX to peer GPIO2 RX in each direction, common ground; both server/client role assignments exercised
scope.esp32_loopback: Internal GPIO input-matrix routing samples TX4 as UART2 RX and TX17 as UART1 RX; this is not a physical wire loopback
scope.pico_loopback: RP2040-Zero physical loopback GP12 TX→GP5 RX and GP4 TX→GP13 RX, native UART DMA
scope.protocol_windows: ESP32 nominal 2 KiB; RP2040 nominal 8 KiB, each direction
scope.fatal_attempt: Fatal-test firmware was compiled only. ESP32 console/device acquisition failed before any firmware write; no hardware fatal/core-dump test occurred.
scope.device_access_complete: ESP32 boards and Pico released; packaging performs no device access

caveats: This is operational validation of the named firmware/SDK/logging route, not a universal upper bound on callback or crash-reporting stack usage.
The final Pico evidence includes visible USB stderr output, ANSI-colored warnings from checksum-valid injected frames, malformed frames, reconnect and verified ping.
Preliminary Pico results are retained for provenance but excluded from full-logging claims and primary totals because stderr output was discarded.
All-stage stack minima include diagnostic warnings/reconnect and different task lifetimes; task numbers disambiguate duplicate RX names within each stage.
Raw logs preserve ANSI escapes and pre-READY boot messages. Fatal/reset rejection applies to the active run beginning at READY; pre-existing boot/core-dump checks are not new probe failures.
Throughput rates are observations for this stack-stress harness with absolute-index pattern validation; they do not replace published headline benchmark rates.
No request was made to back up board flash for this run; no backup or restoration is claimed.
